nodes.description: Mapping address => Holder named Acc holding each user's unlockTime and balance.
External Log contract reference set once in the constructor.
Public minimum balance threshold, initialized to 1 ether.
Holder.balance field inside Acc, the withdrawable deposit tracked per address.
Holder.unlockTime field inside Acc, the time gate for withdrawals.
Log contract Message[] array that stores the message history.
Log contract scratch Message struct reused before each push.
Payable Put(uint _unlockTime) that credits msg.value and sets the caller's unlock time.
Payable Collect(uint _am) that validates the balance/unlock gate then sends ether to msg.sender.
Anonymous payable fallback that forwards to Put(0).
Constructor taking the Log contract address and storing it in LogFile.
Log.AddMessage(address,uint,string) that records sender, value, now and data into History.
msg.sender, the externally controlled caller used as the Acc mapping key and call target.
now / block.timestamp, miner-influenced time used for unlock gates and log timestamps.
msg.sender.call.value(_am)() low-level ether transfer performed before acc.balance is decremented.
_unlockTime argument of Put, caller-supplied unlock timestamp.
_am argument of Collect, caller-supplied withdraw amount also used as call value.
log address argument of the constructor used to initialize LogFile.
_adr argument of AddMessage written into LastMsg.Sender.
_val argument of AddMessage written into LastMsg.Val.
_data argument of AddMessage written into LastMsg.Data.
Storage reference acc = Acc[msg.sender] inside Put.
Storage reference acc = Acc[msg.sender] inside Collect.

edges.reason: msg.sender indexes the Acc mapping to load the caller's Holder record.
Put compares now against _unlockTime, so the stored unlock time depends on miner-controlled block.timestamp.
_am is used directly as the value of the external call to msg.sender.
Collect invokes an external call to msg.sender, which can re-enter Collect or Put.
acc.balance is only decremented after the external call returns, so the balance can be drained by re-entrancy.
The withdrawal gate now > acc.unlockTime in Collect depends on block.timestamp.
MinSum is read as the minimum balance threshold in Collect.
Put calls Log.AddMessage on the externally supplied Log contract after crediting the deposit.
Collect calls Log.AddMessage after decrementing the balance.
The fallback function forwards value to Put(0).
The constructor stores a caller-supplied log address into LogFile without validation.
AddMessage writes now into LastMsg.Time, making log timestamps miner-dependent.
AddMessage appends LastMsg to the History array.
_am is compared against acc.balance inside Collect's guard.

normalization_plan.reason: _unlockTime is only ever consumed by Put, so it can be inlined into the Put node.
_am exists solely to parameterize Collect's guard and withdrawal amount.
log is only used by the constructor to set LogFile.
_adr is only written into LastMsg.Sender inside AddMessage.
_val is only written into LastMsg.Val inside AddMessage.
_data is only written into LastMsg.Data inside AddMessage.
acc is a storage pointer scoped to Put and carries no independent semantics.
acc is a storage pointer scoped to Collect and carries no independent semantics.
